description: This file contains unit tests for the TextFragment and TextSegmentIterator classes, validating string processing functionalities such as substring extraction, trimming, comparison, and iteration over segments within a string.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a segment or fragment of a text string, supporting operations like trimming, comparison, and substring searching.

classes.name: TextSegmentIterator
classes.description: An iterator class to traverse segments within a TextFragment, supporting reset, next, and reverse search operations.

methods.name: TextFragment
methods.description: Constructors for creating a TextFragment instance from a string buffer, with options for offset and length.

methods.name: Index.Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next segment.

methods.name: Index.Remainder
methods.description: Returns the remaining part of the TextFragment after the current position.

methods.name: Index.Current
methods.description: Returns the current TextFragment at the iterator's position.

methods.name: TextFragment.ForwardFind
methods.description: Searches forward in the fragment for a delimiter or character.

methods.name: TextFragment.Clear
methods.description: Clears the content of the TextFragment.

methods.name: TextFragment.TrimBegin
methods.description: Trims the specified prefix from the beginning of the fragment.

methods.name: TextFragment.TrimEnd
methods.description: Trims the specified suffix from the end of the fragment.

methods.name: TextFragment.ReverseFind
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a substring or character.

methods.name: TextFragment.ReverseSkip
methods.description: Skips backwards over the string from a reverse find position.

methods.name: TextFragment.OnMarker
methods.description: Checks if the fragment contains a specified marker.

methods.name: TextFragment.EqualText
methods.description: Compares the fragment's text with a given string or buffer.

methods.name: TextSegmentIterator.Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to the initial position.
